features.title: Designed for fast access
features.text: Designed for today’s dynamic workplaces, Hive Cubby keeps essentials close, secure, and easy to access.

features.title: Organised storage made easy
features.text: Hive’s grab-and-go compartments streamline storage, helping you stay efficient in dynamic office settings.

features.title: Compact height, big utility
features.text: Uniform cubicles make it simple to organise items by team, individual, or category, keeping spaces neat and efficient.

features.title: Clean lines for modern spaces
features.text: A low-height build keeps sightlines clear, serving as both storage and a subtle divider for modern open offices.

features.title: Tough, reliable storage
features.text: A sleek cubby with clean lines and neutral tones, blending seamlessly into offices, classrooms, or shared spaces.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
